hypothesis: On a real Apple GPU adapter, browser WebGPU training has a median step-time speedup above 1.25x over WASM without more than 5% final-loss drift.

comparison.experimental_unit: one backend run on the same browser preset, corpus, seed, and step count

randomization.method: fixed ABBA order balances warmup and thermal drift

metrics.gate: absolute relative drift between paired final losses < 0.05
adapter is present and is not a software or fallback adapter
zero page, console, device-loss, or non-finite-loss errors

resource_envelope.stop_rule: Stop on software/fallback adapter, device loss, non-finite loss, browser error, or 200 steps in any arm.

commands: pnpm --dir browser run webgpu:paired -- --base-url http://127.0.0.1:4173 --preset large --steps 20 --seed 42 --source-revision 4641e910a95cbd554a32d76939a8ba7bd9ac5fef --output ../runs/verified-wins/webgpu-paired-hardware-v1/receipt.json
